ei.title: Charles Frederick Worth — 19세기 최고의 패션 디자이너
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Charles Frederick Worth was the most famous fashion designer of the 19th century. He was born in 1825 in Bourne, Lincolnshire, one of five children. His father abandoned the family by the time he was 11, leaving them impoverished. His mother was left with little choice but to find an apprenticeship for him at a printer’s shop, but the young boy hated the work. He persuaded his mother to allow him to move to London to gain employment at Swan & Edgar, a haberdashery located in the recently constructed Regent Street. There, he was given the opportunity to work with textiles, which gave him an outstanding grounding for the future. Perhaps equally important were his frequent visits to the new National Gallery, within walking distance of Swan & Edgar. Worth’s knowledge of costume history, gained from observing portraits in the National Gallery, was very helpful to his career.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 'abandoned the family, leaving them impoverished' → having left는 오류. 동시 결과를 나타내는 현재분사 leaving이 맞음.
det.analysis:
① born — 수동 과거분사 'He was born in 1825', 정상
② having left ←정답 — 원문은 leaving(단순 현재분사). abandoned와 동시에 일어나는 결과를 나타냄. having left(완료분사)는 선후관계를 뜻하므로 의미 오류
③ located — 수동 과거분사 'a haberdashery located in', 정상
④ gained — 수동 과거분사 'knowledge...gained from observing', 정상
det.tip: leaving = 동시 결과. having left = 선행 완료. 여기는 동시 결과이므로 leaving.

questions.passage: Charles Frederick Worth was the most famous fashion designer of the 19th century. He was born in 1825 in Bourne, Lincolnshire, one of five children. His father abandoned the family by the time he was 11, leaving them impoverished. His mother was left with little choice but to find an apprenticeship for him at a printer’s shop, but the young boy hated the work. He persuaded his mother to allow him to move to London to gain employment at Swan & Edgar, a haberdashery located in the recently constructed Regent Street. There, he was given the opportunity to work with textiles, which gave him <u>an outstanding grounding for the future</u>. Perhaps equally important were his frequent visits to the new National Gallery, within walking distance of Swan & Edgar. Worth’s knowledge of costume history, gained from observing portraits in the National Gallery, was very helpful to his career.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>an outstanding grounding for the future</u>가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 'an outstanding grounding for the future' = 미래를 위한 뛰어난 토대. 직물 작업 경험이 패션 경력의 실무적 기반이 됨.
det.analysis:
① 재정적 안정 — 돈 관련이 아닌 실무 경험
② 실무 경험과 기초 ←정답 — 직물 작업(textiles)을 통해 얻은 실무적 토대가 패션 디자이너 경력의 기반
③ 정서적 성숙 — 감정이 아닌 실무 기술 토대
④ 학문적 교육 — 정규 교육이 아닌 현장 경험
det.tip: grounding = 기초/토대. 직물 작업이라는 실무 경험이 미래 경력의 밑거름.
